title: Kids Peeling Easter Eggs, Gingham Table - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A group of young children gather intently around an outdoor picnic table covered in a classic gingham checkered tablecloth in 1968. The kids, displaying typical late-1960s hairstyles such as hair ribbons, blunt bobs, and crew cuts, are focused on peeling hard-boiled eggs or preparing them for coloring, surrounded by small bowls of treats and snacks. In the lower right corner, the styled coif of an overseeing adult is visible.
